title: Optimal Control of Saddle Node Bifurcations
summary: Nonautonomous saddle node bifurcations commonly appear in mathematical models, however, an optimal control theory tailored to such systems is not yet well established. We present conceptual work on the nonautonomous saddle node normal form. We develop an approach that reformulates the optimal control problem into an unconstrained minimization problem by exploiting a connection between bifurcation and rate-induced overshoots.
